newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain trade almost at standstill.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain trade almost at standstill.

text.p: Trading on the UK physical grain market was at a virtual standstill on Monday.
Prior to the Christmas holiday traders had forecast little or no activity during the two days leading up to New Year and for the rest of the week.
"A lot of grain will be moving around the country during those few days and people that are in will be concentrating on logistics rather than taking fresh positions," said a trader.
"There is nothing going on, call back next Monday," said another.
